acceptance_criteria.label: Bug 1 — candidateCardStyle helper exists and all 3 sites use it
acceptance_criteria.given: file scripts/lib/react_template.tpl has been modified by dev
acceptance_criteria.when: grep is run for 'candidateCardStyle' across the file
acceptance_criteria.then: at least 4 matches found: 1 function/const definition + 3 call sites (accommodation, meals, activities candidate sections); AND (a) grep for borderRadius: '6px' in lines 2390-2560 returns 0 matches (old hardcoded styles removed — unpatched source has 3 matches at L2420/L2475/L2526); AND (b) grep for style={candidateCardStyle( in lines 2390-2560 returns 3+ matches (post-patch expected state — currently 0 on unpatched source, confirming the helper is called in all 3 sites after patching)

check.fail_a_rationale: Unpatched source has 3 matches at L2420 (accommodation), L2475 (meals), L2526 (activities). background: and borderRadius: are on SEPARATE lines (L2419/L2420 etc.) so multi-token single-line patterns cannot detect this. Use grep -F 'borderRadius: '\''6px'\''' scoped to lines 2390-2560.
check.pass_b_rationale: Currently 0 matches on unpatched source; must reach 3 after patching all 3 candidate card style sites. Use grep -F 'style={candidateCardStyle(' scoped to lines 2390-2560.

acceptance_criteria.label: Bug 2 — all 6 image sites use cover_image fallback
acceptance_criteria.given: file scripts/lib/react_template.tpl has been modified by dev
acceptance_criteria.when: each of 6 per-site grep patterns is run against the file
acceptance_criteria.then: all 7 per-site fail-patterns return 0 matches (any non-zero count means that site is still unpatched); AND grep for 'cover_image ||' in lines 860-1850 returns 6+ matches. Note: timeline entry has TWO patterns — guard (L1828) and src (L1830) — both must return 0.
acceptance_criteria.note_on_L1828: Timeline entry image spans TWO lines: '{entry.image && !sm && showDetails && (' on L1828 and '

sites.rationale: Single-line site; unpatched form is 'opt.image &&
Single-line site; unpatched form is 'c.image &&
Single-line site; unpatched form is 'attr.image &&
Single-line site; unpatched form is 'ent.image &&
Single-line site; unpatched form is 'acc.image &&

TWO-LINE SPAN guard check: 'entry.image && !sm && showDetails' on L1828. Matches the guard line. After patching to (entry.cover_image || entry.image) && !sm, returns 0. ALSO requires the src check below (timeline entry src) to catch L1830.

L1830 contains the img src attribute independently from the guard on L1828. A developer who patches only the guard (entry.image && !sm) to use cover_image but leaves src={entry.image} on L1830 would get 0 matches for the guard pattern but still render the unpatched src. Unpatched: grep -F 'src={entry.image}' returns 1 match at L1830. After correct patching to src={(entry.cover_image || entry.image)}, returns 0. Use grep -F 'src={entry.image}' scoped to lines 1828-1835.
